title: The concrete enlarged indexing diagram
statement: Let D be a finite-piece diagram [lem-sc-compact-flat-finite-subcomplex-diagrams], E,t a telescope sequence, and p a compatible augmentation of the source tower into its telescope [def-sc-flat-telescope-stage-map]. On the disjoint union of the source preorder and the target chain, retain the old source and target orders, allow no target-to-source arrow, and put j<=k from source to target exactly when the least cone block through which j factors is at most k. The diagram has source object D(j), target object C_k [def-sc-compact-flat-telescope-blocks], and the factorization map on a mixed arrow.

source.place: The source-bar, finite-cone-block, least-block adjunction and union-bar paragraphs; The concrete enlarged indexing diagram.

proof.text: Finite-piece factorization supplies a nonempty set of block indices. Nat.find gives its least index; choices of factor maps are made only from this proved existence. Naturality of the source augmentation shows the least index is monotone. Define the four cases of the order explicitly and check transitivity. Define maps by the old source map, the chosen factor followed by a block inclusion, the impossible reverse case, and the target transition. Every map commutes with augmentation. Cancellation of a monic target block inclusion proves identity and composition when the last vertex is a target; the all-source case is diagram functoriality.
